title: hoshidicts Korean test

description: A tiny Korean-English dictionary for languages/ko/tests/lookup.tsv, written for hoshidicts (GPL-3.0-or-later). Part-of-speech tags as kty-ko-en writes them. The entry spelled in jamo (ㅁㅓㄱㄷㅏ) is found only if the postprocessor kept the jamo form it joins.
